judgment.zh: 加分：贡献了首个真实生产仓库 LLM 生成代码漏洞数据集（21430 函数/226 仓库/四年挖掘）；集成标注+人工标注并以 Cohen's k=0.79 报告一致性；给出 Zenodo DOI 公开工件；保留来源与 AI 工具元数据支持可复现研究。扣分：下游检测/评测实验在摘要中未展开；静态分析集成标注可能漏报深层漏洞
judgment.en: Bonus: contributes the first vulnerability dataset of LLM-generated code from real production repositories (21,430 functions/226 repos/four years of mining); integrated plus manual labeling with agreement reported as Cohen's k=0.79; public artifacts with a Zenodo DOI; preserves provenance and AI-tool metadata to support reproducible research. Deduction: downstream detection/evaluation experiments not elaborated in the abstract; static-analysis-integrated labeling may miss deep vulnerabilities

papers.title: JANUS: Agentic Cross-Language Fuzzing Harness Generation for Android Native Libraries

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：首个 agent 式跨语言 JNI 感知模糊测试 harness 合成（迭代解析跨语言调用依赖 + 自底向上递归组装复合参数对象）；44 个真实流行应用/21386 个 JNI 方法上有效 harness 达 SOTA 工具 5.9 倍（6094 个）；在五大厂商预装应用闭源本地库中发现 6 个先前未知漏洞。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；新漏洞严重性与厂商响应情况未披露；无消融
judgment.en: Bonus: first agentic cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harness synthesis (iteratively resolving cross-language call dependencies + bottom-up recursive assembly of composite parameter objects); on 44 real popular apps/21,386 JNI methods, valid harnesses reach 5.9× the SOTA tool (6,094); discovers 6 previously unknown vulnerabilities in closed-source native libraries of pre-installed apps from five major vendors. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; severity of the new vulnerabilities and vendor responses undisclosed; no ablation

papers.title: ABSENTIA: Detecting Broken Access Control Vulnerabilities in Web Applications

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了明确的新范式（不变量证伪驱动的越权检测智能体脚手架）；发布 BAC-Bench（30 条 2025 后真实通告、修复提交配对计分）；对 CodeQL/Semgrep/非结构化智能体给出强对比。扣分：通告规模 30 条偏小；LLM 验证器仅确认 51% 的发现
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a clearly defined new paradigm (invariant-falsification-driven agent scaffolding for broken-access-control detection); releases BAC-Bench (30 real post-2025 advisories, fix-commit-paired scoring); strong comparison against CodeQL/Semgrep/unstructured agents. Deduction: advisory scale of 30 is small; the LLM verifier confirms only 51% of findings

papers.title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study

topic.zh: 基准、数据集与评测方法

judgment.zh: 加分：首个带真实执行确认的跨框架 MCP 工具投毒实测（12 框架×18 模型×45 场景共 9720 格 susceptibility matrix）；提出 25 类根因分类法、canary 回执双重预言机并使用卡方统计；开源工具 mcpvenom；完成 5 次跨 4 厂商协同披露并做 12 框架代码级审计。扣分：本质为提示注入类攻击面的测量研究，与代码审计主线相关性偏弱；现有缓解（正则描述扫描 7.2% 误报）仅部分有效；5 次披露均被厂商拒绝，缺乏真实生态修复反馈
judgment.en: Bonus: first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution (a 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix over 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios); contributes a 25-class root-cause taxonomy, a dual canary-receipt oracle, and chi-squared statistics; open-source tool mcpvenom; five coordinated disclosures across four vendors plus a code-level audit of all twelve frameworks. Deduction: essentially a measurement study of a prompt-injection-type attack surface, loosely tied to the code-auditing focus; the examined mitigation (a regex description scanner with a 7.2% false-positive rate) is only partial; all five disclosures were rejected by vendors, so no real-ecosystem remediation feedback

topic.zh: 二进制、固件与逆向分析

judgment.zh: 加分：提出首个无污染、真实规模的逆向工程基准（新评测资源，5000 专家小时、19 个程序/262 实例/1572 任务）；覆盖 11 模型 13 种智能体设定并含确定性评分；消融验证污染控制与真实规模必要性；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：私有程序限制基准完全公开，未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；未可靠识别到局限或有效性威胁章节
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes the first contamination-free, realistic-scale reverse-engineering benchmark (new evaluation resource; 5,000 expert hours, 19 programs/262 instances/1,572 tasks); covers 11 models and 13 agent configurations with deterministic scoring; ablations verify the necessity of contamination control and realistic scale; an identifiable experiments or evaluation section is present. Deduction: proprietary programs limit full benchmark release, and no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; no reliable identification of a limitations or threats-to-validity section

papers.title: PLCBench: Can Autonomous LLM Agents Turn PLC Access into Sustained Physical Impact?

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：首个真实 PLC 硬件在环的 agent 攻击能力基准（4 商用 PLC × 4 闭环负载 × 240 回合）；确定性评估器与六隐藏诊断标志实现独立结果验证；发布代码与软件-only 复现管线。扣分：无真实漏洞披露（授权实验环境）；PLC 与负载覆盖仍有限；缺统计显著性检验
judgment.en: Bonus: first agent attack-capability benchmark on real PLC hardware-in-the-loop (4 commercial PLCs × 4 closed-loop workloads × 240 episodes); deterministic evaluator and six hidden diagnostic flags enable independent result verification; releases code and a software-only reproduction pipeline. Deduction: no real vulnerability disclosures (authorized lab environment); PLC and workload coverage still limited; no statistical significance testing

papers.title: Vulnerability Localization Benchmark: Measuring Agentic Security Analysis at Repository Scale

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了明确的新数据资源与任务（500 真实漏洞/290 仓库的仓库级漏洞定位基准）；27 个模型与 4 个静态工具统一智能体接口评测；含补丁后负控设计揭示虚报行为。扣分：最强系统 File F1 仅 0.229、任务远未解决；工件公开声明在摘要中未明确
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a clearly defined new data resource and task (repository-level vulnerability localization benchmark with 500 real vulnerabilities / 290 repositories); evaluates 27 models and 4 static tools through a unified agent interface; includes a post-patch negative-control design that exposes overreported success. Deduction: the best system reaches only 0.229 File F1, far from solving the task; artifact release not clearly stated in the abstract

papers.title: CESBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Cryptographic Engineering Security for IoT Devices

topic.zh: 基准、数据集与评测方法

judgment.zh: 加分：贡献了密码工程安全这一明显空白领域的全新专家撰写基准(6 子域×4 任务型);11 个开源/闭源模型全量作答,双家族 LLM judge 交叉+人工复核验证评分;明确公开基准/提示词/逐题结果工件;覆盖侧信道/故障注入等此前较少评测的安全实现能力。扣分：条目为专家知识型构造、非源自真实项目或 CVE 实证;未识别到去污染/记忆泄漏控制设计;380 条规模偏中等、未报告统计检验
judgment.en: Bonus: contributes a novel expert-written benchmark for cryptographic engineering security, a clearly underexplored area (6 subdomains × 4 task types); full responses from 11 open/closed-source models with scores validated by cross-family dual LLM judges plus manual re-check; explicit public release of benchmark/prompt/per-question result artifacts; covers security implementation capabilities such as side channels and fault injection that were rarely evaluated before. Deduction: items are expert-knowledge constructions not derived from real projects or CVEs; no decontamination or memorization-leakage control design identified; moderate scale of 380 items with no statistical tests reported

papers.title: Towards a Risk Assessment of Malicious Skill Files in Coding Agents

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了对抗技能合成方法并贡献 2826 条映射 ATT&CK 的技能基准；评测管线含运行分层、三裁判 LLM 评审并经人工金标准校验（kappa 0.85）；覆盖两个企业级 agent 共 5629 次真实运行；给出开源工件与数据集。扣分：攻击为合成生成而非真实在野样本；结果对生成模型近不变的机制解释有限；属编码 agent 自身风险评估而非代码审计主线
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes an adversarial skill synthesis method and contributes a 2826-skill benchmark mapped to ATT&CK; evaluation pipeline includes run stratification and three-judge LLM review calibrated against human gold labels (kappa 0.85); covers 5629 real runs across two enterprise agents; provides open-source artifacts and dataset. Deduction: attacks are synthetically generated rather than real in-the-wild samples; limited mechanistic explanation of near-invariance across generator models; concerns coding-agent self-risk rather than the code-audit mainline

papers.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection

topic.zh: 安全代码评审与静态分析
topic.en: Secure Code Review and Static Analysis

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了明确的新范式（执行反馈驱动的 CodeQL 查询自动精化，免标注免模板）；多基准（Juliet/FormAI）与三家商业 LLM 验证；修复官方 3 个长期未决 issue 并在 libpng/zlib 发现真实漏洞。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a clearly defined new paradigm (execution-feedback-driven automated refinement of CodeQL queries, label-free and template-free); validated on multiple benchmarks (Juliet/FormAI) and three commercial LLMs; fixed 3 long-standing official issues and found real vulnerabilities in libpng/zlib. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: VEX-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Assessing Exploitability of Software Supply Chain Vulnerabilities

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：首个供应链漏洞可利用性评估基准（75 个真实 GitHub 案例、专家标注、Python/Java/Go 三语言）；9 模型 × 3 框架系统评测并量化二分类与细粒度理由差距；开源代码与数据。扣分：案例规模中等；仅评估已知漏洞可利用性判定、无新漏洞发现；缺消融
judgment.en: Bonus: first supply-chain vulnerability exploitability-assessment benchmark (75 real GitHub cases, expert-annotated, Python/Java/Go); systematic evaluation of 9 models × 3 frameworks quantifying the gap between binary judgment and fine-grained reasoning; code and data open-sourced. Deduction: moderate case scale; only assesses exploitability judgment of known vulnerabilities with no new vulnerability discovery; no ablation

papers.title: Autonomous OSS Threat Detection via Taxonomy-Aligned LLMs

topic.zh: 软件供应链、恶意代码与软件包
topic.en: Software Supply Chain, Malicious Code, and Software Packages

judgment.zh: 加分：贡献 AV-xxx 分类法与 999 条真实安全事件、八生态数据集并开源；与八种基线对比并揭示「分类法对齐胜过微调」的反直觉结论。扣分：GitHub Actions 类别宏 F1 仅 0.367 暴露类别不平衡；依赖 GPT-4 标注存在成本与规模化限制
judgment.en: Bonus: contributes the AV-xxx taxonomy and a dataset of 999 real security incidents across eight ecosystems, open-sourced; compared with eight baselines and reveals the counterintuitive finding that taxonomy alignment beats fine-tuning. Deduction: GitHub Actions macro F1 of only 0.367 exposes class imbalance; reliance on GPT-4 annotation entails cost and scaling limits

papers.title: From Runnable to Verifiable: An Independent Reproducibility Study of LLM/Agent-Driven Vulnerability Validation Artifacts

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：预注册的可复现性审计协议（R0/R1 修复阶梯、G1-G3 语义证据级、补丁反事实 oracle 与阴性对照）；104 篇共识语料 + 102 个锚点用例全量执行；贡献可复用的安全可复现性评测模板。扣分：18 篇抽样执行规模有限；未识别到协议/工件的明确公开发布声明；结论自认为探索性
judgment.en: Bonus: pre-registered reproducibility audit protocol (R0/R1 repair ladder, G1-G3 semantic evidence levels, patch counterfactual oracle and negative controls); full execution over a 104-paper consensus corpus + 102 anchor cases; contributes a reusable security-reproducibility evaluation template. Deduction: sampled execution limited to 18 papers; no clear public release statement for the protocol/artifacts; conclusions self-described as exploratory

papers.title: The History Is the Detector: Executing CVE Patch History, End-to-End

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了明确的新范式（CVE 修复历史转化为可执行检测规则加漏斗式运行时验证流水线）；覆盖 19,325 CVE 到 1,033 规则再到 14 个程序 644 项运行时证据的全链条。扣分：规则构造依赖修复提交可得性；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a clearly defined new paradigm (converting CVE fix history into executable detection rules plus a funnel-style runtime verification pipeline); covers the full chain from 19,325 CVEs to 1,033 rules to 644 runtime evidence items across 14 programs. Deduction: rule construction depends on the availability of fix commits; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

Deduction: no clear open-source release statement for the paper's own artifacts identified; results obtained mostly in a deterministic sandbox, deployment-level DeFi security unverified; concerns DeFi agent execution security rather than contract code auditing proper (adjacent)

papers.title: CS-Guard: Benchmarking LLM Guardrails for Code Generation Security

judgment.en: Bonus: first benchmark for code-generation safety guardrails plus a new attack, FSA; systematic evaluation across 9 guardrails × 7 models; provides an open-source benchmark and data. Deduction: malicious generation prompts are constructed scenarios rather than real malicious samples; some guardrail conclusions rest on a single evaluation protocol

papers.title: What is the Difference Between Me and You? Benchmarking the Quality Gap Between Human-Written and AI-Generated Code

judgment.en: Bonus: large-scale human-AI code-quality comparison of 780k function pairs mapped to ODC/CWE; contributes the CQBench benchmark and open-sources it; covers three languages and three assistants. Deduction: static-analysis findings are not equivalent to real vulnerabilities; the security dimension is only part of the analysis

papers.title: MobileCybench: Evaluating Agent Vulnerability Discovery via Executable Probes

judgment.zh: 加分：提出可执行安全属性探针的漏洞报告评测框架（新评测范式，可发现编写时未知的漏洞）；495 探针×13 个真实 Android 应用×5 智能体×4 设定；报告了真实漏洞发现/披露（23 个未报告漏洞多数获维护者确认）；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：探针由作者编写与评审、独立性有限；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes an evaluation framework for vulnerability reports based on executable security-property probes (new evaluation paradigm, able to find vulnerabilities unknown at writing time); 495 probes × 13 real Android apps × 5 agents × 4 settings; reports real vulnerability disclosures or maintainer confirmation (23 previously unreported vulnerabilities, most confirmed by maintainers); an identifiable experimental evaluation section is present in the paper. Deduction: probes written and reviewed by the authors, with limited independence; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code

judgment.zh: 加分：构建 CASE-Bench：145 个源自 51 个真实项目 CVE 的仓库级任务（Docker 化、双向 PoC 验证、安全相关上下文标注）；系统比较 13 种上下文构建方法×6 个 LLM 并做单要素编辑与编码智能体轨迹分析；量化了功能导向上下文对生成代码安全性的隐性损害。扣分：摘要未明确基准与工件的开源发布；以评测已有上下文策略为主、方法学新贡献有限；安全判据依赖 PoC 验证，向非 CVE 缺陷泛化未知
judgment.en: Bonus: constructs CASE-Bench with 145 repository-level tasks derived from real CVEs in 51 projects (Dockerized, bidirectionally PoC-validated, with security-relevant context annotations); systematically compares 13 context construction methods across 6 LLMs with single-element edits and coding-agent trajectory analysis; quantifies how functionality-oriented context silently harms the security of generated code. Deduction: no explicit open-source release of the benchmark or artifacts stated in the abstract; mainly evaluates existing context strategies with limited methodological novelty; the security oracle depends on PoC validation, and generalization to non-CVE defects is unknown

judgment.zh: 加分：提出意图桥不变量违反与结算暴露的分类法及协议感知模糊测试新方法；LLM 兜底参数构造体现神经符号融合；在 24 个真实部署上确认 17→22 个真实不变量违反，均可对公开部署字节码复现；结构恢复/函数分类/变异体多级量化评估。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；变异体实验规模较小（23 个）；误报率与人工确认成本未充分报告

Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; small mutant study (23 mutants); false-positive rate and manual confirmation cost underreported

papers.title: Peer Pressure: Execution-Verified Co-Evolution of Attacker and Defender Populations for Code Security

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：执行验证的攻防共进化训练范式（PRPO 将种群置于策略梯度基线 + 同条件对局消除难度混淆）；跨未见应用/未训练语言的 OOD 评测与多对照组；7B 审查器超监督微调与冻结前沿模型并在越狱防御上迁移有效。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；训练算力成本与泛化边界披露有限；验证依赖测试与 exploit 复现路径
judgment.en: Bonus: execution-verified attack-defense co-evolution training paradigm (PRPO places the population in the policy-gradient baseline + matched-condition matchups eliminate difficulty confounds); OOD evaluation on unseen applications/untrained languages with multiple control groups; a 7B reviewer surpasses supervised fine-tuning and frozen frontier models and transfers effectively to jailbreak defense. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; limited disclosure of training compute cost and generalization boundaries; verification relies on tests and exploit-reproduction paths

papers.title: Towards Effective Fuzzing of EDK2 Components

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出直接依赖组件重托管加 LLM 辅助 harness 合成的 edk2 模糊测试新系统 Metis；覆盖率约达 SOTA FuzzUEr 的 1.7 倍；发现 137 个未知漏洞，26 个已上报、含 12 个可远程触发并全部获厂商确认。扣分：摘要未给出开源工件或复现包的明确声明；仅与单一 SOTA 方法对比且缺少统计检验；范围局限于 UEFI 引导组件这一特定生态
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes Metis, a new edk2 fuzzing system combining direct-dependency component rehosting with LLM-guided harness synthesis; achieves about 1.7x the coverage of the state-of-the-art FuzzUEr; discovers 137 previously unknown bugs, with 26 reported, 12 remotely triggerable, and all acknowledged by vendors. Deduction: the abstract gives no explicit statement of open artifacts or a reproduction package; comparison is limited to a single state-of-the-art technique without statistical testing; scope is confined to the specific UEFI bootloader ecosystem

papers.title: Proving the Wrong Program: Miscompilations as a Threat to zkVM Guarantees

judgment.zh: 加分：首次系统实证编译器错误编译对 zkVM 正确性保证的威胁；用 LLM 智能体从 LLVM IR 恢复 Rust 触发器并自动构造表面正常的触发补丁；覆盖 SP1 与 Jolt 两大生产 zkVM 及 20 个真实项目的 552 组 guest-bug 验证。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；攻击覆盖受限于已知编译器缺陷清单，未含未发现缺陷；缺乏对其他 zkVM 实现的横向验证
judgment.en: Bonus: presents the first systematic empirical study of compiler miscompilation as a threat to zkVM guarantees; uses an LLM agent to recover Rust triggers from LLVM IR-only bugs and automatically craft innocuous-looking trigger patches; validates across two production zkVMs (SP1 and Jolt) and 552 guest-bug pairs from 20 real projects. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; attack coverage is bounded by the inventory of known compiler bugs, excluding undiscovered defects; no horizontal validation on other zkVM implementations

papers.title: PatchBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Vulnerability Patching

judgment.zh: 加分：量化揭示补丁记忆（约 25% 与历史补丁高相似）与崩溃栈表面修复两大评测威胁（新基准+新验证方法）；漏洞移植与代码变异降低记忆与表面修复风险；覆盖 11 个智能体（含 AIxCC 前三）并证明 PoC-only 验证虚高 1.83 倍；补丁经安全+语义双重验证；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：基准依赖漏洞移植构造而非原生存储库上下文；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: quantitatively reveals two evaluation threats: patch memorization (~25% highly similar to historical patches) and crash-stack surface fixes (new benchmark + new validation method); vulnerability transplantation and code mutation reduce memorization and surface-fix risks; covers 11 agents (including the AIxCC top three) and shows PoC-only validation inflates results 1.83×; patches verified on both security and semantics; an identifiable experimental evaluation section is present in the paper. Deduction: benchmark relies on transplanted vulnerabilities rather than native repository context; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

judgment.en: Bonus: large-scale manual analysis (500 false-positive samples, 167 CVEs / 110 projects) builds a five-category false-positive taxonomy; query-level refinement eliminates 81.8% of reviewed false positives while retaining 7/8 true positives; evaluates cross-project refinement transfer of the agent tool. Deduction: fixed refinements depend on project-specific context, limiting generalization; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; limited scale of the self-built evaluation set; limited component-level differences from existing memory-agent/taint-detection frameworks; precision (80.68%) leaves room for improvement

papers.title: Rethinking Neural Decompilation: Candidate Selection as the Hidden Bottleneck

topic.zh: 二进制、固件与逆向分析

judgment.zh: 加分：将神经反编译瓶颈重新定义为候选选择问题并提出生成-选择流水线；发布含 362647 个 OLLVM 混淆样本的 ExeBench-Obfuscated 新数据资源；以 88.8% pass@1 推翻已有检查点不适用于混淆输入的结论。扣分：评测以标准基准加合成混淆为主，真实世界二进制占比有限；最优选择器在跨基准间不一致，静态选择泛化性存疑；未声明选择流水线代码与训练流程开源
judgment.en: Bonus: reframes the neural decompilation bottleneck as candidate selection and proposes a generate-then-select pipeline; releases the new ExeBench-Obfuscated data resource with 362,647 OLLVM obfuscated samples; overturns prior claims that released checkpoints are unsuitable for obfuscated inputs, reaching 88.8% pass@1. Deduction: evaluation is dominated by standard benchmarks plus synthetic obfuscation, with limited real-world binaries; the best selector is inconsistent across benchmarks, casting doubt on static-selector generalization; no explicit statement that the selection pipeline code and training recipe are open-sourced

papers.title: When LLM Decompilers Recompile More and Preserve Less

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了行为差异比较 oracle（驱动合成 + 语料生长 + 差分重放）揭示再编译指标盲区；8 系统 9 配置 + 300 真实 GitHub 函数 + 287 个 CVE 函数的多重证据。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；整体分歧率绝对值较小（4.9%），工程影响需进一步验证
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a behavioral-difference comparison oracle (driver synthesis + corpus growing + differential replay) exposing blind spots of recompilation metrics; multiple evidence lines from 8 systems/9 configurations + 300 real GitHub functions + 287 CVE functions. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; overall divergence rate is small in absolute terms (4.9%), and engineering impact needs further validation

papers.title: Function Name Is All You Need to Detect Blockchain Application Attacks

judgment.zh: 加分：提出仅凭函数名序列捕获交易高层语义、无需源码与规则的新检测范式；424 起真实攻击事件/14,611 笔攻击交易与 5 亿+主网良性交易的大规模实证；误报率约 0.0017%、单笔 24.90ms 支持实时检测。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；未可靠识别到消融与统计显著性检验；以已知攻击事件回放为主，前瞻捕获零日攻击的能力未验证
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a new detection paradigm that captures high-level transaction semantics from function-name sequences alone, requiring no source code or rules; large-scale evidence from 424 real attack incidents/14,611 attack transactions and 500M+ benign mainnet transactions; ~0.0017% false positive rate and 24.90ms per transaction support real-time detection. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; no reliable identification of ablation studies or statistical significance testing; mainly replays known attack incidents, with prospective zero-day capture capability unverified

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Detecting Description-Execution Mismatch Attacks in DAO Governance

judgment.zh: 加分：首次系统研究 DAO 治理描述-执行失配（DEMI）攻击检测；DAO 无关仿真框架 + 逐动作证据映射 LLM 范式属方法创新；大规模真实以太坊 DAO 治理数据（92.7% 活跃 DAO 可仿真）；红蓝对抗下自适应攻击稳健性评估且跨 LLM 供应商泛化。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；检测精确率上限（81.7%）受 LLM 能力约束；非以太坊 DAO 与跨链治理的泛化未验证
judgment.en: Bonus: first systematic study of DAO governance description-execution mismatch (DEMI) attack detection; the DAO-agnostic simulation framework plus per-action evidence-mapping LLM paradigm is a methodological innovation; large-scale real Ethereum DAO governance data (92.7% of active DAOs simulatable); robustness against adaptive attacks evaluated under red-blue teaming with cross-LLM-vendor generalization. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; detection precision ceiling (81.7%) is constrained by LLM capability; generalization to non-Ethereum DAOs and cross-chain governance unverified

topic.zh: 二进制、固件与逆向分析

judgment.zh: 加分：首个人类与 LLM 逆向工程能力/工作流对照研究（新视角，统一评分细则+IDA 全程交互记录）；9 模型统计比较并含代码表示消融；4,000 真实二进制的上下文饱和度测量；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：人类对照任务仅两个、规模有限；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: first comparative study of human vs. LLM reverse-engineering capability/workflows (new perspective; unified scoring rubric + full IDA interaction logs); statistical comparison of 9 models with a code-representation ablation; context-saturation measurement on 4,000 real binaries; an identifiable experiments or evaluation section is present. Deduction: only two human-comparison tasks, limited scale; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: SEMPRE: Semantic-Aware Protocol Reverse Engineering via Consistency-Driven Joint Optimization

topic.zh: 二进制、固件与逆向分析

judgment.zh: 加分：提出 LLM 推理与污点/循环轨迹动态分析联合优化的协议逆向框架（神经符号融合，EM 式收敛）；对 6 个 SOTA 基线大幅领先且含组件消融；真实僵尸网络案例验证实用性；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；未可靠识别到局限或有效性威胁章节
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a protocol reverse-engineering framework jointly optimizing LLM reasoning with taint/loop-trace dynamic analysis (neuro-symbolic fusion, EM-style convergence); substantially outperforms 6 SOTA baselines with component ablations; practicality validated on a real botnet case; an identifiable experiments or evaluation section is present. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; no reliable identification of a limitations or threats-to-validity section

papers.title: Keeping Fuzzers on Duty: Repairing Fuzzing Build Breakages in Continuous Open-Source Fuzzing

judgment.zh: 加分：首次针对 OSS-Fuzz 持续模糊测试构建失败提出证据引导诊断+修复状态图（分支/回滚）智能体 FuzzMedic；在 128 个可复现真实失败（抽取自 1820 个）上达 48.44% 修复率、优于 3 个程序修复基线；真实落地 29 个补丁被上游合并（含 3 个搁置超一年案例与 2 个从未构建成功案例）。扣分：摘要未明确代码/工件的开源声明；评测限于 OSS-Fuzz 单一平台，跨模糊测试平台泛化未知；未报告统计显著性检验
judgment.en: Bonus: presents FuzzMedic, the first agent for OSS-Fuzz build-breakage repair using evidence-guided diagnosis and a repair-state graph with branching and rollback; achieves a 48.44% repair rate on 128 reproducible real failures (extracted from 1,820), outperforming three program-repair baselines; 29 patches merged upstream in real-world use, including three failures unresolved for over a year. Deduction: no explicit open-source statement for the code or artifacts in the abstract; evaluation is limited to the single OSS-Fuzz platform with unknown cross-platform generalization; no statistical significance tests reported

judgment.en: Bonus: zero-trust unit architecture with object-binding constraints (kernel sandbox + broker object-level adjudication + one-time authorization); 74-item attack set including replays of 10 publicly disclosed incidents, evaluated with ground-truth oracles; baselines (allowlists/command sandbox) fail 56-66 items while the proposed scheme fails only 2; 3.2k-line Rust prototype with measured latency. Deduction: benign-workflow completion rate of 4/7 remains limited; residual risk from 14 pending reviews and 2 failures; no public artifact release statement identified; coding-agent containerization defense rather than auditing

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了明确的新方法与工具（StringGroup 字符串组上下文抽取 + Secretron）；在 SecretBench 上 98.74% F1 优于 LLM 基线并覆盖混淆与跨语言场景；报告了真实部署中发现 48 个未知密钥的证据。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；真实部署误报细节披露有限；以单一基准为主，缺统计显著性检验
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a clearly defined new method and tool (StringGroup string-group context extraction + Secretron); 98.74% F1 on SecretBench outperforming LLM baselines, covering obfuscation and cross-language scenarios; reports evidence of 48 previously unknown secrets found in real deployments. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; limited disclosure of real-deployment false-positive details; single-benchmark focus with no statistical significance testing

papers.title: One Pipeline Does Not Fit All: TAILOR, a Type- and State-Aware Framework for CVE Reproduction

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：类型感知 + 状态感知两级机制的 CVE 复现多 agent 框架（前置状态构造与触发解耦）；200 个复杂执行需求 CVE 数据集 + 两级消融；Web 59.24%/传统 44.19% 复现率并打包可审计复现证据。扣分：复现率绝对水平仍偏低；数据集与工件公开声明模糊；与既有复现方法的直接对比有限
judgment.en: Bonus: type-aware + state-aware two-level multi-agent framework for CVE reproduction (decoupling precondition-state construction from triggering); a 200-CVE dataset of complex execution requirements + two-level ablations; 59.24% Web/44.19% traditional reproduction rates with auditable reproduction evidence packaged. Deduction: absolute reproduction rates remain low; dataset and artifact release statements ambiguous; limited direct comparison with existing reproduction methods

papers.title: Adaptive Code Revision Attacks on AI Pull Request Reviewers

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：反馈引导代码修订攻击的新威胁建模（利用评审反馈修复表面问题同时保留漏洞）；AFCRA-Bench 基于 159 个已披露漏洞并附可执行 exploit 验证；5 轮交互下成功率 2.5×/12.5× 于最强基线。扣分：攻击有效性依赖特定评审者模型版本；防御侧评估有限；基准公开声明模糊
judgment.en: Bonus: new threat model of feedback-guided code revision attacks (using review feedback to fix surface issues while retaining vulnerabilities); AFCRA-Bench builds on 159 disclosed vulnerabilities with executable exploit validation; success rates 2.5×/12.5× over the strongest baselines within 5 interaction rounds. Deduction: attack effectiveness depends on specific reviewer-model versions; limited defense-side evaluation; ambiguous benchmark release statement

papers.title: LLM-based Code Auditing by Inferring and Evaluating Developer Assumptions

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：信念引导漏洞检测新范式（推断开发者安全信念并推导违反条件），可发现时序侧信道等语法工具难覆盖的语义缺陷；提出解释型检测的 recall/overhead 度量；真实基准上取得最优效果-开销折中。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；基准规模与 CWE 覆盖描述有限；缺统计显著性检验
judgment.en: Bonus: new belief-guided vulnerability detection paradigm (inferring developer security beliefs and deriving violation conditions), able to find semantic defects such as timing side channels that syntax-based tools miss; proposes recall/overhead metrics for explanation-based detection; achieves the best effectiveness-overhead trade-off on real benchmarks. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; limited description of benchmark scale and CWE coverage; no statistical significance tests

papers.title: P2Patch: Exploit-Guided Vulnerability Repair

judgment.zh: 加分：提出补丁即攻击目标的生成式对抗修复范式（新范式，累积 PoV 全部阻断才通过）；101 个真实 C/C++/Java CVE 上验证并以留出 exploit oracle 评估；修复覆盖超越单轮修复与 SOTA 智能体修复系统；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：摘要未见功能回归测试的明确声明（严谨维度受修复类规则约束）；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；未可靠识别到局限或有效性威胁章节
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a new adversarial repair paradigm in which the patch itself is the attack target (passing requires blocking all accumulated PoVs); validated on 101 real C/C++/Java CVEs and assessed with a held-out exploit oracle; repair coverage exceeds single-pass repair and SOTA agentic repair systems; an identifiable experimental evaluation section is present in the paper. Deduction: no explicit statement of functional regression testing in the abstract (soundness constrained by repair-class rules); no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; no reliable identification of a limitations or threats-to-validity section

papers.title: Do Coding Agents Understand Why Systems Crash---and Why They Don't?

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：源码干预配对设计（同输入仅单源码树崩溃）排除可疑代码混淆因子；934 对 Linux/OSS-Fuzz 真实崩溃对 × 4 agent 的系统性偏差分析（漏报偏向、远距因果误判）。扣分：预测型评测与实际修复/审计能力有距离；数据集发布声明模糊；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: source-intervention paired design (same input crashing in only one source tree) rules out suspicious-code confounders; systematic bias analysis of 934 real Linux/OSS-Fuzz crash pairs × 4 agents (false-negative skew, distant-causality misjudgment). Deduction: predictive evaluation is distant from actual repair/audit capability; dataset release statement ambiguous; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: Simple Features Beat Most AI Control Monitors

topic.zh: 基准、数据集与评测方法

judgment.zh: 加分：揭示主流后门代码检测评测集中作者风格与标签泄漏两类捷径；给出严格受控的逐类作者交换实验与漏洞效度检查；公开重建数据集与检查工具。扣分：结论主要基于单一评测数据集，外推性有限；未提出新的检测方法，仅限基准批判；已发表监测器是否依赖该捷径仅为推测而非实证
judgment.en: Bonus: exposes authorship-style and label-leakage shortcuts in a mainstream backdoored-code detection benchmark; provides rigorously controlled one-class-at-a-time author-swap experiments and backdoor validity checks; releases the rebuilt dataset and checks. Deduction: findings rest mainly on a single evaluation dataset, limiting generalization; no new detection method is proposed, only a benchmark critique; reliance of published monitors on these shortcuts remains conjectural

papers.title: When Verified Source Becomes Attack Input: Defending Smart Contracts Against LLM-Based Vulnerability Scanning

judgment.zh: 加分：提出抵御恶意 LLM 合约漏洞扫描的部署结构变形防御这一新问题定义；使用 387 个真实漏洞合约×3 个 LLM 智能体评估；含跟踪分析与消融分析；验证层设计具备可部署参考价值。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；评估环境派生自单一基准（SCONE-bench），外部效度有限；对合法授权审计成本的影响未充分量化
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a new problem definition of deployment-time structure-morphing defense against malicious LLM contract-vulnerability scanning; evaluated with 387 real vulnerable contracts × 3 LLM agents; includes trace analysis and ablation analysis; verification-layer design offers deployable reference value. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; evaluation environment derived from a single benchmark (SCONE-bench), limiting external validity; impact on legitimate authorized-audit cost insufficiently quantified

papers.title: DistillGuard: Malicious NPM Package Detection and API Attack Chain Analysis via Static Graph and LLM Distillation

topic.en: Software Supply Chain, Malicious Code, and Software Packages

judgment.zh: 加分：静态图语义+LLM 蒸馏的轻量恶意 npm 包检测框架，可离线部署；F1 领先 SOTA 基线 11-30pp 并总结八条 API 攻击链供防御参考。扣分：摘要未说明数据集构成与去污染设计；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明

Deduction: abstract does not describe dataset composition or decontamination design; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: COMPASS: Predicting the Relationship of Multiple Patches for Vulnerabilities with LLMs

judgment.zh: 加分：首次形式化多补丁关系（6 类型）并给出 LLM 预测方法；千级人工分析加开发者访谈加 300 CVE 基准，平均超 SOTA 85%；公开查询网站。扣分：任务为补丁知识管理、非检测定位本身；下游采用效果未验证
judgment.en: Bonus: first to formalize multi-patch relations (6 types) and give an LLM prediction method; thousand-scale manual analysis plus developer interviews plus a 300-CVE benchmark, outperforming SOTA by 85% on average; public query website. Deduction: the task is patch knowledge management rather than detection or localization itself; downstream adoption effects unverified

papers.title: Newer and Bigger, but Safer? A Longitudinal Study of the Functionality-Security Gap in LLM-Generated Code

judgment.zh: 加分：覆盖 32 个 LLM、七家族三代的纵向安全实证；以受控轨迹推翻既有「开源不安全」结论并给出 CWE×语言级分析。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；依赖单一基准 CWEval
judgment.en: Bonus: longitudinal security study covering 32 LLMs across seven families and three generations; controlled trajectories overturn the prior "open-source is unsafe" conclusion and provide CWE × language-level analysis. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; relies on a single benchmark, CWEval

papers.title: SEEK: Agentic Knowledge Graph Retrieval for Secure Code Generation

judgment.zh: 加分：提出 CWE 本体+真实 CVE 修复实例的安全知识图谱 agentic RAG 框架；跨五模型两基准并含 13 个未见 CWE 的分布外泛化评估与延迟分析。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；知识图谱构建成本未量化
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a security knowledge-graph agentic RAG framework built on a CWE ontology plus real CVE fix instances; evaluated across five models and two benchmarks, including out-of-distribution generalization on 13 unseen CWEs and latency analysis. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; knowledge-graph construction cost not quantified

papers.title: When File Ingestion Misleads Language Models: Measuring and Mitigating Divergences in Office Documents

judgment.zh: 加分：系统刻画 OOXML 提取分歧新攻击面（19 个人类不可见通道+12 个内容丢失通道，静态+动态分析结合）；构造 5 类攻击并使 4 大聊天助手与 4 个编码智能体全部被至少一种攻击误导；提出 Prism 轻量防御且对未见载荷具有泛化性。扣分：提取分歧属 LLM 应用输入完整性问题，与代码安全审计主线相关性偏弱；防御的开销与误报未量化；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: systematically characterizes the extraction-divergence attack surface in OOXML ingestion (19 hidden channels and 12 content-dropping channels via combined static and dynamic analysis); five attacks mislead all four major chat assistants and four coding agents by at least one attack; the Prism defense is lightweight and generalizes to unseen payloads. Deduction: extraction divergence is an input-integrity problem for LLM applications, loosely tied to the code-security auditing focus; defense overhead and false-positive rates are not quantified; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出了三 agent 任务-线索编排框架以支撑非线性黑盒渗透（分支切换、失败复盘、长程线索关联）；在 10 个新发布 HTB 靶机上设 token 预算并与 PentestGPT-V2/Claude Code 对比，取得两个 root。扣分：仅 HTB 靶场而非真实授权环境；规模较小且无消融与统计检验；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a three-agent task-lead orchestration framework supporting nonlinear black-box penetration (branch switching, failure retrospection, long-horizon lead association); token-budgeted comparison against PentestGPT-V2/Claude Code on 10 newly released HTB machines, achieving two roots. Deduction: HTB lab only rather than real authorized environments; small scale with no ablation or statistical testing; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: KubeCap: A Framework for Capability Minimization in Kubernetes via Static Analysis and LLM-Assisted Rule Inference

topic.zh: 安全代码评审与静态分析
topic.en: Secure Code Review and Static Analysis

judgment.zh: 加分：提出首个 K8s 能力最小化框架（可达性系统调用分析加 LLM 辅助规则推断）；3 数据集实证 74.67% 项目缺配置，10 项目平均削减 54.97% 能力。扣分：对象为部署配置加固、漏洞检测属性弱；以 Go 项目为主；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes the first K8s capability-minimization framework (reachability-based syscall analysis plus LLM-assisted rule inference); 3 datasets empirically show 74.67% of projects lack configuration, and 10 projects achieve an average 54.97% capability reduction. Deduction: the subject is deployment-configuration hardening with weak vulnerability-detection properties; dominated by Go projects; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: SpiderSapien: Client-Centric Web Crawler and Security Scanner

judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a scanner with immersive client-side interactive crawling and LLM-based form solving; at least 46% coverage improvement on real web applications and XSS found in 7 applications. Deduction: method is a combinational improvement over existing ideas; mainly horizontal scanner comparisons with insufficient statistical testing; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: LLMSec-AV: A Vulnerability Taxonomy and LLM-Driven Software Weakness Discovery Framework for Autonomous Vehicles

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：AV 专用 18 类弱点分类法 + LLM 分析框架；以 46 处上游修复弱点位与旗量匹配置换基线对照，并同场比较 CodeQL/Semgrep/cppcheck/Clang（含加 AV 规则后）；生成 fuzzing harness 以 AFL++ 实测。扣分：分类法对召回无增益（作者自认仅改善归类可解释性）；抽样函数规模有限；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: AV-specific 18-class weakness taxonomy + LLM analysis framework; evaluates on 46 upstream-fixed weak spots against a flag-count-matched replacement baseline, and compares CodeQL/Semgrep/cppcheck/Clang in the same setting (including with AV rules added); generates fuzzing harnesses tested with AFL++. Deduction: the taxonomy yields no recall gain (authors acknowledge it only improves categorization interpretability); limited sampled-function scale; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: BenchShield: Formal Model-Backed Instrumentation for Reward Integrity in LLM-Agent Evaluation Infrastructure

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：形式化生命周期模型支撑的阶段感知污点分析 + 运行时证据归因双通道奖励完整性检测；456 条人工裁决轨迹（来自 31k 公开运行）训练评估并与 agent 扫描器基线对比提升明显。扣分：属评测基础设施安全而非代码审计主线；语料与工件开放迹象模糊；运行时检测在自建环境内验证
judgment.en: Bonus: stage-aware taint analysis grounded in a formalized lifecycle model + dual-channel reward-integrity detection with runtime evidence attribution; 456 human-adjudicated trajectories (from 31k public runs) for training and evaluation, with clear gains over agent-scanner baselines. Deduction: evaluation-infrastructure security rather than the code-audit mainline; ambiguous signals of corpus and artifact openness; runtime detection validated only in a self-built environment

papers.title: PentestChain: A Cost-Aware, MCP-Orchestrated Framework for Automated Penetration Testing with Free-Tier LLMs

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：将美元成本作为一等评估指标并实测零付费 API 成本运行；MCP 暴露面威胁模型与四项缓解；多试次统计（pass-at-k、非参数检验）并同靶场直接复现 PentestGPT/PentestAgent 基线。扣分：摘要成果有限且被截断（仅旧版靶标 26 服务/34 CVE 富化）；真实渗透效果未证；框架工件开放迹象模糊
judgment.en: Bonus: treats dollar cost as a first-class evaluation metric and demonstrates runs at zero paid API cost; MCP attack-surface threat model with four mitigations; multi-trial statistics (pass-at-k, non-parametric tests) and direct same-range reproduction of PentestGPT/PentestAgent baselines. Deduction: abstract shows limited results and appears truncated (only legacy-target enrichment of 26 services/34 CVEs); real-world penetration effectiveness unproven; ambiguous signs of framework artifact release

papers.title: CASHEWS: Source Preprocessor for LLM-based Malicious Package Detection

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：反混淆 + 捆绑提取 + 恶意 sink 反向切片 + 字面量压缩的 LLM 检测预处理管线；512 大文件 × 2 扫描器 × 3 LLM 上覆盖率 69.1-85.7%→98.8-100%，漏报降 18.6pp 且净成本降 34.6%。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；在野恶意包真实检出证据有限；贡献偏工程性预处理
judgment.en: Bonus: LLM detection preprocessing pipeline of deobfuscation + bundle extraction + malicious-sink backward slicing + literal compression; on 512 large files × 2 scanners × 3 LLMs, coverage rises from 69.1-85.7% to 98.8-100%, false negatives drop 18.6pp, and net cost falls 34.6%. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; limited evidence of real detection on in-the-wild malicious packages; contribution leans toward engineering preprocessing

papers.title: SelfOp: An Optimization Algorithm for Self-Improving Security Agents

judgment.zh: 加分：提出链式文本梯度式的安全智能体上下文自优化算法（新范式，共识提交+收敛检测）；在 CyberGym 真实漏洞复现任务上小于 200 样本获 17-18.5 分自提升；优化技能可跨模型迁移；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：仅单一安全基准（CyberGym）验证；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；未可靠识别到局限或有效性威胁章节
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a chained-textual-gradient-style context self-optimization algorithm for security agents (new paradigm, consensus commit + convergence detection); achieves 17-18.5 point self-improvement on real CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks with fewer than 200 samples; optimized skills transfer across models; contains an identifiable experimental evaluation section. Deduction: validated on a single security benchmark (CyberGym) only; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; no reliable identification of a limitations or threats-to-validity section

papers.title: Cheap to Hypothesize, Costly to Verify: The Defense Surface of Agentic Vulnerability Discovery

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出假设-验证不对称防御面与可认证安全诱饵 RedHerring（私钥证书 + 计算难解性）；33 个 OSS-Fuzz 项目 × 5 模型匹配预算实验，真实漏洞发现降 38.7-60.4%，含知情基线控制与轨迹分析。扣分：诱饵为注入构造而非真实代码演化；对更强验证器的对抗性讨论有限；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes the hypothesis-verification asymmetry defense surface and the certifiably secure decoy RedHerring (private-key certificates + computational hardness); budget-matched experiments on 33 OSS-Fuzz projects × 5 models, reducing real vulnerability discovery by 38.7-60.4%, with informed-baseline controls and trajectory analysis. Deduction: decoys are injected constructions rather than real code evolution; limited adversarial discussion of stronger verifiers; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: SecureVibe: Making Vibe Coding More Secure

topic.zh: 安全代码评审与静态分析
topic.en: Secure Code Review and Static Analysis

judgment.zh: 加分：提出面向安全规划与测试行为的训练配方（SFT+RL+提示自监督三路）；4 个基准含未见 CWE 泛化并同时改善功能性。扣分：属训练配方增量改进；基准为标准安全编码集；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a training recipe targeting secure planning and testing behaviors (SFT + RL + prompt self-supervision); 4 benchmarks including generalization to unseen CWEs while improving functionality. Deduction: an incremental improvement to training recipes; benchmarks are standard secure-coding sets; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: Aletheia: Permission-Minimality Testing for Coding-Agent Rules

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：权限最小性差分测试框架（逐权限删除 + 可信沙箱受限重放 + 功能测试判定）；314 条攻击规则全检出、85 条良性规则仅 3 误报；单规则 44 秒/0.22 美元成本可承受。扣分：攻击规则来自单一基准（AIShellJack）；良性规则规模小；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；属编码 agent 配置安全而非漏洞审计
judgment.en: Bonus: permission-minimization differential testing framework (per-permission removal + trusted-sandbox restricted replay + functional-test verdicts); detects all 314 attack rules with only 3 false positives on 85 benign rules; affordable per-rule cost of 44 seconds/$0.22. Deduction: attack rules come from a single benchmark (AIShellJack); small benign-rule scale; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; coding-agent configuration security rather than vulnerability auditing

papers.title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments

judgment.zh: 加分：提出黑客-修复循环的弱到强验证器自动加固流水线（可借鉴工具链）；跨 Terminal Bench/KernelBench/SETA 三环境验证且随预算扩展；早期版本被 Terminal Bench 官方仓库采纳（工程落地证据）；给出项目页面。扣分：加固对象为评测基础设施验证器而非真实软件漏洞；未可靠识别到局限或有效性威胁章节
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a weak-to-strong verifier auto-hardening pipeline via hack-fix loops (reusable toolchain); validated across Terminal Bench/KernelBench/SETA with budget scaling; an early version adopted by the official Terminal Bench repository (engineering adoption evidence); provides a project page. Deduction: hardening targets evaluation-infrastructure verifiers rather than real software vulnerabilities; no reliable identification of a limitations or threats-to-validity section

papers.title: Trojan Horse: Automated Repository Poisoning against Coding Agents

topic.zh: 基准、数据集与评测方法

judgment.zh: 加分：提出首个代码仓库级自动化投毒框架(AST 解析+执行迹映射+对抗式伪装精炼);贡献 TrojanBench(384 个投毒仓库×6 域×9 语言)及跨 4 harness×12 模型的系统评测;基于真实开源仓库与真实 coding agent 验证供应链投毒可行性。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明;缺少与既有检测/防御基线的对比评估;可提取的消融与统计检验信息较少
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes the first repository-level automated poisoning framework (AST parsing + execution-trace mapping + adversarial camouflage refinement); contributes TrojanBench (384 poisoned repositories × 6 domains × 9 languages) and a systematic evaluation across 4 harnesses × 12 models; validates supply-chain poisoning feasibility on real open-source repositories with real coding agents. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; lacks comparative evaluation against existing detection/defense baselines; little extractable information on ablations and statistical tests

papers.title: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：多 agent 迭代假设探索 + 独立观测执行效果的可验证 exploit 合成框架（PoE）；WebExploitGym 覆盖 25 个真实 Web 应用/5 语言/7 框架，验证 10 项真实公告并新发现 4 项可利用性证明。扣分：10/25 复现率与 4 项新发现规模有限；新发现的披露/确认状态未知；无消融；未识别到工件公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: verifiable exploit-synthesis framework (PoE) combining multi-agent iterative hypothesis exploration with independent observation of execution effects; WebExploitGym covers 25 real web applications/5 languages/7 frameworks, verifying 10 real advisories and newly discovering 4 exploitability proofs. Deduction: 10/25 reproduction rate and 4 new discoveries are limited in scale; disclosure/confirmation status of the new discoveries unknown; no ablation; no public artifact release statement identified

papers.title: Kerkoporta: Injecting Structured-Output Backdoors in Reasoning Coding Agents

topic.zh: 基准、数据集与评测方法

judgment.zh: 加分：提出针对智能体编码场景的结构化输出后门这一新攻击范式；覆盖多模型与多框架并验证最高 96.2% 攻击成功率与效用保持；投毒构造与轻量 RL 恢复流水线对红队与模型供应链防御有直接参考价值。扣分：未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；缺少统计显著性检验与系统消融的明确描述；攻击仅在自训开源模型上验证，未涉及真实第三方模型分发渠道
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a new attack paradigm of structured-output backdoors in agentic coding settings; validates up to 96.2% attack success with preserved utility across multiple models and harnesses; the poisoning construction and lightweight RL recovery pipeline offer direct reference for red-teaming and model-supply-chain defense. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; no explicit description of statistical significance testing or systematic ablations; the attack is validated only on self-trained open-weight models, not through real third-party model distribution channels

papers.title: Signed, Sealed, Leaked: Trust Beyond Signature for MCP Toolchains

topic.zh: 安全代码评审与静态分析
topic.en: Secure Code Review and Static Analysis

judgment.zh: 加分：提出种系执行这一无需信任工具实现的数据隔离新机制并给出汇点非干扰性证明；153 次攻击运行中零未授权泄露且保持 10-49ms 延迟；实证揭示签名信任与 SOTA 运行时防御 MCPGuard-Dynamic 的失效。扣分：属智能体工具链防护，与 AI 代码审计主线关联较弱；副本约束与无数据种系等隔离假设的实用性论证有限；未声明工件开源
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes germline execution, a novel data-isolation mechanism that does not trust tool implementations, with a proof of sink noninterference; achieves zero unauthorized disclosures across 153 attack runs at 10-49 ms latency; empirically exposes the failure of signature-based trust and the state-of-the-art runtime defense MCPGuard-Dynamic. Deduction: belongs to agent-toolchain protection and is only weakly related to the mainline of AI-based code auditing; limited practical argument for isolation assumptions such as copy confinement and a data-free germline; no explicit statement of open artifacts

papers.title: A Gingerbread House for LLM Agents: Source-Planned Honeypots That Lure Autonomous Attackers into an Isolated Shadow

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出基于源码规划的静态蜜罐+影子隔离防御新范式：CVE-Bench 40 个关键任务上真实攻陷从 26/40 降至 5/40（Claude Opus 4.8）、20/40 降至 0/40（ARTEX），且在 20 个设计外新任务保持 0/20；诚实报告影子内利用成功等残余风险及增强配置无显著差异的局限。扣分：评测限于 CVE-Bench 与两类攻击者、规模有限；运行时 responder 的独立贡献未被隔离验证；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a source-planned static honeypot with shadow isolation as a new defense paradigm: on the 40 critical CVE-Bench tasks real compromise drops from 26/40 to 5/40 (Claude Opus 4.8) and from 20/40 to 0/40 (ARTEX), holding at 0/20 on 20 held-out tasks; honestly reports residual risks such as exploits succeeding on the shadow and the non-significant difference between configurations. Deduction: evaluation is limited to CVE-Bench and two attackers at small scale; the independent contribution of the runtime responder is not isolated; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

judgment.en: Bonus: generics-aware Rust fuzz-target generation (GRAFT) combining structured API analysis + topological traversal + compile-error feedback; 96.19% compilation success and 80.75% macro-averaged API coverage on 13 real crates.io libraries, outperforming RULF/RPG by 4.76×/2.43×. Deduction: small benchmark scale (13 crates); no new crashes or vulnerabilities reported; no ablation; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

judgment.zh: 加分：编译器精确静态分析 + LLM 工件生成的大规模实证（3700 组、含无静态上下文消融与朴素模板基线）；给出构建集成失败分类与诚实的负结果。扣分：预算内未动态确认任何候选弱点（37 个崩溃均源自桩代码）；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；结论受单一软件栈限制
judgment.en: Bonus: large-scale empirical study of compiler-precise static analysis + LLM artifact generation (3,700 pairs, with no-static-context ablations and naive-template baselines); provides a build-integration failure taxonomy and honest negative results. Deduction: no candidate weakness dynamically confirmed within budget (all 37 crashes originate from stub code); no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; conclusions limited to a single software stack

judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a novel stealthy backdoor attack surface for reasoning code LLMs (context injection + model-unfaithfulness disguised reasoning chains); systematic evaluation across 4 backdoor target types × 6 reasoning models × 3 coding tasks × 3 defenses; covers previously understudied evaluation dimensions such as human-inspection evasion. Deduction: no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; attack scenario uses self-constructed triggers and lacks validation on real supply-chain poisoning; little extractable information on ablations and statistical tests

papers.title: Compaction Laundering: Provenance Destruction in Context-Compacting Coding Agents

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：发现上下文压缩即信任边界破坏的新攻击面（5 个扁平化 harness 87-100% 洗白率对照角色化 harness 0%）；追踪至真实执行后果（curl|sh 沙箱执行、真实 TUI 约 50%）并给出序列化层修复与 77% 检出方案。扣分：属编码 agent 基础设施安全而非代码审计主线；配对实验在受控环境；未识别到工件公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: uncovers a new attack surface where context compression breaks the trust boundary (87-100% laundering rate across 5 flattened harnesses vs 0% for role-based harnesses); traces real execution consequences (curl|sh sandbox execution, ~50% on a real TUI) and proposes serialization-layer fixes plus a 77% detection approach. Deduction: coding-agent infrastructure security rather than the code-audit mainline; paired experiments in controlled environments; no artifact release statement identified

papers.title: Post-SQLFix: Property-Guided Repair of LLM-Generated SQL with Runtime Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：将 Text-to-SQL 修复重构为性质引导程序修复：方言感知规范化查询结构+三层静态分析+Verify-Before-Apply 时序监视化解「仲裁悖论」；在 BIRD/Spider/Mini-Dev 3 基准、3 种方言、6 种模型配置上修复 EF 遗留执行错误的 77.8%，token 减少 30%，准确率最高 +11.6pp。扣分：修复对象是 SQL 功能正确性而非安全漏洞，与漏洞修复主线相关性偏弱；依赖标准基准、缺少真实生产负载；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: reformulates Text-to-SQL repair as property-guided program repair, resolving the arbitration paradox via a dialect-aware canonical query structure, a three-layer static analyzer, and a verify-before-apply temporal monitor; across BIRD, Spider, and Mini-Dev with 3 dialects and 6 model configurations it repairs 77.8% of execution errors left by EF, uses 30% fewer tokens, and gains up to +11.6pp accuracy. Deduction: the repair target is SQL functional correctness rather than security vulnerabilities, loosely tied to the vulnerability-repair focus; relies on standard benchmarks without real production workloads; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: The Long Con on the Web: Earn-then-Exploit Fraud Attacks against Coding Agents

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出「先取信后利用」的编码智能体网络欺诈新攻击面并给出信任依赖的行为学证据；系统构建 56 个组织环境评测三个主流编码智能体（ASR 71.4%）；提出动作-授权分离（AAS）防御，将攻击成功率降至 0% 且保持 100% 任务完成。扣分：攻击环境为自建合成场景而非真实生产部署；防御仅在一组设定下验证，缺少跨攻击类型与更强自适应攻击者的压力测试；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: identifies the earn-then-exploit web fraud attack surface against coding agents with behavioral evidence of trust reliance; systematically builds 56 organizational environments and evaluates three mainstream coding agents (71.4% ASR); the action-authorization separation (AAS) defense reduces ASR to 0% while preserving 100% task completion. Deduction: attacks are evaluated in self-constructed synthetic environments rather than real deployments; the defense is validated in a single setting without stress testing against adaptive attackers; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

judgment.en: Bonus: first systematic exploration of the efficiency-attack surface of FEM solvers; proposes a domain-guided LLM-agent framework combining an FEM-specific intermediate representation and a deterministic validity gate; covers 3 FEM stacks, 17 problem classes, and 1,068 seeds with up to a 5,752.72x amplification of solver iterations, outperforming five black-box baselines and evolutionary search under a bounded action space. Deduction: efficiency attacks are measured by runtime amplification without validation of real production impact; no discussion of defenses or mitigations; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：构建 350+ 节点/1250+ 关系的 O-RAN 安全知识图谱与确定性+LLM 混合抽取管线；查询产出三项可行动发现；开源数据库、管线与查询。扣分：图谱正确性与 LLM 抽取质量缺系统评估；偏知识管理而非代码审计；发现仅限自建语料范围
judgment.en: Bonus: builds an O-RAN security knowledge graph with 350+ nodes/1,250+ relations and a deterministic+LLM hybrid extraction pipeline; queries yield three actionable findings; database, pipeline, and queries open-sourced. Deduction: graph correctness and LLM extraction quality lack systematic evaluation; leans toward knowledge management rather than code auditing; findings limited to the self-built corpus scope

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Cross-Session Attacks via Persistent Artifacts in Agent Skill Composition

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：刻画跨会话技能组合三类攻击机制（指令传播/数据边界违反/证据投毒）并构建 270 例 SkillRelayBench；7 模型 × 3 框架评测 + SkillRelayGuard 将 ASR 69.5%→10.9% 且良性任务完成率上升。扣分：场景为构造对抗案例而非在野攻击；基准与防御器公开迹象模糊；与安全代码审计主线关联偏间接
judgment.en: Bonus: characterizes three cross-session skill-composition attack mechanisms (instruction propagation / data-boundary violation / evidence poisoning) and builds the 270-case SkillRelayBench; 7 models × 3 frameworks evaluation + SkillRelayGuard cuts ASR from 69.5% to 10.9% while benign task completion rises. Deduction: scenarios are constructed adversarial cases rather than in-the-wild attacks; ambiguous signals of benchmark and defender openness; indirectly related to the secure code-audit mainline

papers.title: CWE-bench: Refocusing Agentic Security from Exploitation to Defense

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：攻转守的仓库级审计-修复基准（120 任务/73 CWE/8 语言/覆盖 OWASP Top 10 全类）；程序化验证器经裁判面板校验与人工复核；给出 pass@1/@4、成本与类别维度分析。扣分：基准私有不公开、独立可复现性受限；无新漏洞披露；跨机构结果不可复核
judgment.en: Bonus: attack-to-defense repository-level audit-repair benchmark (120 tasks/73 CWEs/8 languages/covering all OWASP Top 10 categories); programmatic validator calibrated via a judge panel and manual review; reports pass@1/@4, cost, and category-dimension analyses. Deduction: the benchmark is private and unreleased, limiting independent reproducibility; no new vulnerability disclosures; cross-organization results cannot be re-verified

papers.title: VulDec: Vulnerability Detection in Binaries via Neural Decompilation

topic.zh: 二进制、固件与逆向分析

judgment.zh: 加分：构建多架构汇编-源码对齐且带 CWE 标注的大规模数据集（新数据资源）；首个以神经反编译为中心的二进制漏洞检测端到端框架；以 3% 现实漏洞率测试集评估；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：检测宏 F1（0.61）处早期水平、可提取的量化结果较少；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；未可靠识别到局限或有效性威胁章节
judgment.en: Bonus: builds a large-scale multi-architecture assembly-source aligned dataset with CWE annotations (new data resource); first end-to-end binary vulnerability detection framework centered on neural decompilation; evaluated with a test set at a realistic 3% vulnerability rate; contains an identifiable experimental evaluation section. Deduction: detection macro F1 (0.61) at an early level with few extractable quantitative results; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; no reliable identification of a limitations or threats-to-validity section

papers.title: Beyond Smart Homes: Characterizing IoT Vulnerabilities Across Sectors, Vendors, and Products

judgment.zh: 加分：基于 15,000+ 条真实 IoT CVE 的跨行业/厂商细粒度弱点画像；CPE 富化流水线（词法匹配+模糊聚类+LLM 辅助分类）可复用；「同厂商跨产品弱点相似性高于同产品跨厂商」的发现可直接指导修复优先级。扣分：LLM 仅作辅助标注工具、AI 方法深度有限；分类准确率与人工验证规模在摘要中未交代；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；可提取的量化结果较少
judgment.en: Bonus: fine-grained cross-sector and cross-vendor weakness profiling over 15,000+ real IoT CVEs; the CPE enrichment pipeline (lexical matching, fuzzy clustering, LLM-assisted classification) is reusable; the finding that vendor-level factors dominate weakness inheritance directly informs remediation prioritization. Deduction: LLMs serve only as labeling tools with limited methodological depth; classification accuracy and manual validation scale are not reported in the abstract; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; few extractable quantitative results

papers.title: Beyond Prompt Injection: The Tool Update Gap in LLM Agent Security

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：揭示并系统评测「工具更新信任缺口」这一智能体供应链新型攻击面（ETUDE 完全绕过模型上下文防御）；覆盖 Gemini CLI、Codex CLI、Claude Code 等 7 个主流框架，ASR 97.6% 且保持 95.9% 正常任务完成；考察了现有防御的不足。扣分：以攻击演示为主、未提出或验证系统性防御；未报告统计显著性检验；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: reveals and systematically evaluates the tool update gap as a new agentic supply-chain attack surface (ETUDE operates entirely outside the model context); covers 7 mainstream frameworks including Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and Claude Code with 97.6% ASR while maintaining 95.9% legitimate task completion; examines the insufficiency of existing defenses. Deduction: primarily an attack demonstration without a proposed or validated systematic defense; no statistical significance tests reported; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

judgment.zh: 加分：形式化 agent 捷径利用现象并以轨迹级裁判审计两基准 × 3 模型（60.7-90.1% 尝试率）；干预实验显示独立构造提示可压至 9.4-14.2% 且保核心性能。扣分：属 SE 基准评测有效性研究、与安全代码审计主线关联弱；裁判标注缺人工校验细节；未识别到工件公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: formalizes agent shortcut exploitation and audits two benchmarks × 3 models with trajectory-level judges (60.7-90.1% attempt rates); intervention experiments show independently constructed prompts compress this to 9.4-14.2% while preserving core performance. Deduction: an SE benchmark-evaluation validity study weakly related to the security code auditing mainline; judge annotations lack manual-validation details; no artifact release statement identified

papers.title: Beyond Static Guarantees: Measuring the Static-Pass Dynamic-Fail Gap in Security-Sensitive and LLM-Generated Python Code

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出 SPDF 现象与三段式 agent 管线（Bandit-Semgrep 静态门 + LLM CWE 推理 + Docker 隔离动态验证）；1355 样本跨三数据集量化确认率（整体 14.53%）。扣分：评估依赖安全评测数据集（合成比重高）；动态确认含 LLM 判定成分、误报率未知；基线对比薄弱；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes the SPDF phenomenon and a three-stage agent pipeline (Bandit-Semgrep static gate + LLM CWE reasoning + Docker-isolated dynamic verification); quantifies confirmation rates (14.53% overall) on 1355 samples across three datasets. Deduction: evaluation relies on security benchmark datasets (high synthetic proportion); dynamic confirmation includes LLM judgment with unknown false-positive rate; weak baseline comparison; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Security Debt in LLM Coding Agents

topic.zh: 模糊测试、动态分析与利用验证
topic.en: Fuzzing, Dynamic Analysis, and Exploit Verification

judgment.zh: 加分：提出轨迹级安全债务度量 SDLI；830 次 SWE-bench + 712 次 ProgramBench 真实运行与四 SAST 工具交叉测量；诚实区分扫描器发现与确认漏洞。扣分：作者自认仅为扫描器信号而非确认漏洞率；度量对等价 API 重写敏感；对 agent 的实际 steering 价值未证；未识别到工件公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes SDLI, a trajectory-level security-debt metric; cross-measured over 830 real SWE-bench + 712 ProgramBench runs with four SAST tools; honestly distinguishes scanner findings from confirmed vulnerabilities. Deduction: authors acknowledge it is only scanner signal, not confirmed vulnerability rate; metric sensitive to equivalent API rewrites; unproven practical steering value for agents; no artifact release statement identified

papers.title: ContractLens: Latent Security Knowledge for Malicious Smart Contract Detection

judgment.zh: 加分：提出基于 LLM 内部潜在表征（线性探针+恶意判别单元 MCDU）的可解释恶意合约检测新方法；含神经元掩码对照、行为保持扰动稳定性检验及跨模型/少样本泛化评估。扣分：训练数据来源与对比基线细节在摘要中不明，标准实验存缺；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明；可提取的量化结果较少；面向恶意合约分类而非漏洞审计，任务面较窄
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes an interpretable malicious-contract detection method based on LLM internal latent representations (linear probes + malicious-discrimination units, MCDU); includes neuron-mask controls, behavior-preserving perturbation stability checks, and cross-model / few-shot generalization evaluation. Deduction: training data provenance and baseline details unclear in the abstract, standard experiments incomplete; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; few extractable quantitative results; targets malicious-contract classification rather than vulnerability auditing, a narrow task scope

topic.zh: 软件供应链、恶意代码与软件包

Deduction: conventional machine-learning combination improvement; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; confused samples are artificially constructed rather than natural drift

papers.title: API Secrets Should Never Become Tokens in the LLM's Vocabulary: A Threat Analysis of API Credential Handling in LLM Agent Systems and an Empirical Evaluation of a Vault-Mediated Execution Boundary

judgment.zh: 加分：形式化 agent 凭据暴露威胁链并综合真实平台事件与 OWASP/NIST 证据；给出生产实现的黑盒实验并诚实报告负结果。扣分：样本量小且为单产品功能评估；无统计设计与外部基线；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: formalizes the agent credential-exposure threat chain and synthesizes real platform incidents with OWASP/NIST evidence; provides black-box experiments on a production implementation and honestly reports negative results. Deduction: small sample size and single-product feature evaluation; no statistical design or external baselines; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: CodeMimicry: Exploiting Safety Generalization Lag in Large Language Models via Structured Code Completion

judgment.en: Bonus: identifies delayed security generalization as a new failure mode and proposes a fully automated black-box jailbreak framework; evaluated across eight commercial models with latent-space mechanism analysis. Deduction: evaluation relies on LLM-generated/constructed attack samples; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified; lacks defense-side effectiveness validation

papers.title: When Context Gets Root: Privilege Escalation in LLM Harnesses

topic.zh: 安全代码评审与静态分析
topic.en: Secure Code Review and Static Analysis

judgment.zh: 加分：提出并系统评估了新攻击类（编码智能体上下文的指令层级提权）；覆盖 6 个编码智能体框架×13 个攻击目标，含权限审查与持久化任务复现。扣分：属 Agent 上下文攻击而非源码漏洞研究；证据为受控 PoC、无真实披露；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes and systematically evaluates a new attack class (instruction-hierarchy privilege escalation in coding-agent context); covers 6 coding-agent frameworks × 13 attack targets, including permission review and persistence-task reproduction. Deduction: constitutes agent-context attack rather than source-code vulnerability research; evidence limited to controlled PoCs with no real disclosures; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified

papers.title: CodePoisonRAG: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation

judgment.zh: 加分：提出针对检索增强代码生成的 CWE 定向知识投毒框架（漏洞注入+语义误标）；85 个投毒工件跨 3 生成器验证（ASR 0.80-0.93）并评估 CodeGuarder 防御；全文存在可识别的实验评测章节。扣分：投毒工件为构造产物、非真实生态证据；方向为漏洞注入而非修复、与主线价值间接；未识别到论文自身工件的明确公开声明
judgment.en: Bonus: proposes a CWE-targeted knowledge-poisoning framework against retrieval-augmented code generation (vulnerability injection + semantic mislabeling); 85 poisoned artifacts validated across 3 generators (ASR 0.80-0.93) with the CodeGuarder defense evaluated; contains an identifiable experimental evaluation section. Deduction: poisoned artifacts are constructed products rather than real-ecosystem evidence; direction is vulnerability injection rather than repair, only indirectly aligned with the mainline; no clear public release of the paper's own artifacts identified
